source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify SATA Configuration defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without changing the required AHCI/RAID/VMD mode, hiding ports or disks, damaging RAID metadata, breaking boot/filesystems or risking data integrity.
original_method: Manually load BIOS defaults, compare named SATA fields with SPEC, apply a bounded field/port/controller matrix, save and use the documented reset, verify persistence plus controller, port, disk, RAID, boot and filesystem state read-only.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually accept SATA firmware fields, default restore and persistence. Automated storage inventories are read-only supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Named fields mapped to ports, disks, boot roles, controller mode, RAID/VMD and hot-plug/power behavior
SPEC defaults and approved non-default values
Persistent disk identities, array membership, mount/filesystem/workload state and backup confirmation
Known-good boot path, independent console/OOB and storage recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or switch AHCI/RAID/VMD, alter RAID metadata, disable a populated port or change boot storage without exact approval.
No write, format, erase, RAID create/delete/rebuild or destructive benchmark is authorized.
Identify OS, mounted, protected and array-member disks by persistent identity; do not rely on /dev names or port order alone.
Verify backups and independent recovery before any field that can hide or remap storage.
Stop on missing/remapped disk, degraded array, boot/filesystem anomaly, link errors or management loss.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only controller/mode, port/disk persistent IDs, link state, RAID membership/health, boot entries, block/mount/filesystem metadata, kernel logs and BMC status.
Compare approved expected deltas without opening disks for write or changing arrays/drivers.
Do not drive BIOS, modify storage/RAID metadata or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact fields, affected disks/arrays, expected mapping, reset type, backup and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default firmware phases.
Interpret storage, boot, filesystem and health evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS controller-mode, RAID or disk operations are unsafe, non-equivalent substitutions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add version-recorded read-only controller/port/disk, RAID, boot, mount and health collection only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each BIOS field to controller mode and persistent port/disk/array identities; diff visibility, link, RAID membership, boot, mount and health evidence across default, persistence and final states without writes.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact SATA topology, backplane, controller firmware/mode and disk/array population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, storage inventory/RAID tool, OS/kernel, driver and disk/controller firmware versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SATA Configuration documentation and approved controller/RAID guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with topology-specific, non-destructive scenarios and explicit metadata protection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds controller mode, RAID, boot and filesystem integrity coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/port/disk map, mode, values, backup, reset and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Device names and port enumeration may change; persistent disk identities and array metadata are required.

project_override_considerations: A project may select named controllers, ports, disks and safe fields. Results must state excluded disks, arrays, hot-plug/power and boot scenarios and cannot claim full SATA coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform/topology identity, field/port/disk/default matrix, approvals, backup and recovery
Baseline persistent disk IDs, controller mode, ports/links, arrays, boot, mount/filesystem and health evidence
Load Default captures plus SPEC and storage-state comparison
Non-default captures, persistence and exact expected mode/port/disk deltas
Approved final state, anomaly logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Exact modes, ports and disks are project readiness inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SATA configuration lifecycle is clear. Missing topology, backup or recovery must gate execution but does not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds mode/RAID identity, write-protection and recovery safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its SATA/RAID/boot/filesystem evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from read-only storage evidence and prohibits unapproved data or RAID-metadata operations.

review_improvement: Prevents a persisted SATA value from being accepted when disks remap, an array degrades, controller mode changes or the boot/filesystem path is endangered.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core acceptance is interactive firmware configuration and visual verification. Read-only SATA evidence validates consequences but cannot complete that manual work, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat SATA changes, resets or recovery after disk, array, boot, filesystem, link or health anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
